events.content: Thanks for calling Nova Studio. I can help collect the details and schedule a specialist. May I ask your name?
This is Asha. I need help setting up an AI voice agent for my clinic website.
Thanks Asha. What is the best email or phone number for follow-up?
asha@example.com. Tomorrow afternoon works if someone can explain intake automation.
I found a slot tomorrow at 3 PM. Should I schedule it and send a confirmation email?
You're booked for tomorrow at 3 PM. I will send a short summary to the specialist.
User Asha needs help with AI voice-agent intake automation. Next step: specialist demo tomorrow at 3 PM. Contact: asha@example.com.
